item.title: Oil Prices Climb on Fears of Broader Energy Crunch
item.description: Hopes for an end to the war in Iran faded after President Trump failed to secure a commitment from China to help persuade Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Delivering Mail on Ukraine’s Front Line
item.description: Larysa Navrotska risks her life to deliver mail, retirement checks and medicine to remote Ukrainian communities under the constant threat of Russian drones from the nearby front line. Her service has become even more crucial than it was before the war.

item.title: Archaeologists Find Egyptian Mummy Buried With the ‘Iliad’
item.description: For the deceased of Roman-era Egypt, Greek literature may have offered a cheat code to a more comfortable afterlife.

item.title: Earthquake Shakes Tehran, Where Nerves Are Already Strained by Iran War
item.description: Iranian media said a moderate quake had shaken the capital around midnight local time.

item.title: What to Know About Day 2 of Trump and Xi’s Beijing Summit
item.description: President Trump and China’s leader, Xi Jinping, emphasized stability but announced no major breakthroughs on points of contention like trade, Taiwan and the war in Iran.

item.title: Live Updates: Trump Says He and Xi Talked Extensively About Taiwan
item.description: As President Trump left Beijing, he and Xi Jinping, China’s leader, played up stability. There was no indication that they had resolved any major points of contention on Taiwan, the war in Iran or other issues.

item.title: U.S. Intelligence Shows Iran Retains Substantial Missile Capabilities
item.description: Secret new assessments say Iran has operational access to 30 of its 33 missile sites along the Strait of Hormuz, suggesting that its military remains far stronger than President Trump has asserted.

item.title: U.S. Might Restart Strikes on Iran, Trump and Hegseth Warn
item.description: With talks at an impasse, both sides are holding to positions their opponents call unacceptable, while the economic pain caused by the Strait of Hormuz blockade continues to grow.

item.title: Gulf Countries Arrest Shiite ‘Traitors’ Amid War With Iran
item.description: Dozens of Gulf citizens have been accused of belonging to Iran-linked terrorism cells as the war accelerates a shift toward deeper authoritarianism in the region.

item.title: Trump Is in China as Iran War Continues With No End in Sight
item.description: Before leaving Washington on Tuesday, the president reiterated threats to decimate Iran if it doesn’t agree to a deal to resolve the conflict.
